sentences.en: It's sometimes hard to know what stories we should tell when we're in the middle of a crisis.
sentences.zh: 有时在身处危机之中时，很难知道我们该讲述什么样的故事。

sentences.en: Some people need a story that helps them escape.

sentences.en: Others need a story that directly confronts our anxiety.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则需要一个直面我们焦虑的故事。

sentences.en: What I love about the episode we have for you today is that it's really both,
sentences.zh: 我今天带给大家的这一期节目，最棒的地方就在于它两者兼具，

sentences.en: and it also happens to be one of the most beautiful stories this show has ever produced.
sentences.zh: 而且它恰好也是本节目制作过的最美的故事之一。

sentences.en: A few years ago, we toured the West Coast with the rest of Radiotopia,

sentences.en: performing live stories on stage to sold-out crowds.
sentences.zh: 在爆满的观众面前现场表演故事。

sentences.en: For our part of the show, 99% Invisible collaborated with John Moellum and the Brink Players,

sentences.en: which featured members of the Decembrists and Black Prairie.
sentences.zh: 其中还有“十二月党人”和“黑色草原”乐队的成员参与。

sentences.en: It was the story of Jeannie Chance,
sentences.zh: 这是一个关于珍妮·钱斯的故事，

sentences.en: a woman whose voice held a shaken city together in a time of crisis.
sentences.zh: 在危机时刻，正是她的声音将一个濒临破碎的城市凝聚在了一起。

sentences.en: Even though the story of an earthquake in Alaska in 1964 has nothing directly to do
